purpose: Downloads selected videos from URLs using yt-dlp and verifies audio presence via ffprobe. Maintains a TOML manifest to track source information and commentary eligibility for each downloaded file.

public_api.name: DownloadOutcome
public_api.role: Dataclass holding the result for one video download: video_id, filename (if downloaded), manifest entry, and failure flag. Returned by download_all_videos().

public_api.name: download_all_videos
public_api.role: Main entry point. Downloads kept candidates from a CSV file using parallel workers, verifies audio with ffprobe (configurable), and writes or updates the sources.toml manifest. Parameters control candidate path, output directory, worker count, and whether to skip audio checks. Returns list of DownloadOutcome.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point. Parses command-line arguments (--candidates-csv, --output-dir, --workers, --allow-missing-audio, --video-only) and calls download_all_videos(). Returns 0 for success, 2 if ≥50% of tasks failed.
